name: The Walt Disney Studios
notes: Listed in the ETC working group as Disney/Marvel Studios. Its own post and VFX delivery specifications are behind a partner portal and are not public.

name: Disney Live Action
notes: Registered separately from DI in the DCNC studio registry.

name: Walt Disney Animation Studios
notes: Camera capture built into the existing Maya pipeline rather than beside it. Long lineage of camera engineering — multiplane in the 1930s, CAPS in the 1990s.

name: Pixar Animation Studios
notes: Publishes craft writing through RenderMan Stories but no naming specification.

name: Marvel Studios
notes: Named in the ETC contributor list as Disney/Marvel Studios.

name: Lucasfilm Ltd.
notes: Listed as Lucasfilm/ILM. The 'sw' Star Wars franchise prefix appears as a worked example in the ETC spec.

name: 20th Century Studios
notes: Fox Corp is in the ETC member list; TCF is the legacy 20th Century Fox code, TCS the current one.

name: Searchlight Pictures
notes: Formerly Fox Searchlight — the FX code is the legacy registration.

name: Warner Bros. Entertainment
notes: ETC member organisation. HBO is listed separately as an industry contributor.

name: Universal Pictures
notes: Chaired the ETC Adaptive Production VFX Working Group. The 'un' NBCU studio prefix is the spec's own worked example.

name: DreamWorks Animation
notes: Listed among ETC industry contributors. Lighting and camera are separate departments in its CG pipeline.

name: Illumination
notes: No DCNC studio code found in the registry as of this build.

name: Paramount Pictures
notes: ETC member organisation.

name: Sony Pictures Entertainment
notes: ETC industry contributor.

name: Sony Pictures Imageworks
notes: No separate DCNC code. Its Spider-Verse work is the best-documented deliberate departure from photoreal CG grammar in the studio system.

name: Amazon MGM Studios
notes: AMZN and XM are both deprecated registrations superseded by AMGM.

name: Netflix
notes: The only major with a publicly published shot-naming specification and a published capture standard.

name: Blumhouse Productions
notes: Its grammar is downstream of a budget ceiling rather than of a look.

name: Legendary Entertainment
notes: ETC industry contributor.

name: Industrial Light & Magic
notes: Carries both a DCNC studio code and the ETC vendor-code example 'im'. Every shot it has produced carries a globally unique progressive number.

name: Digital Domain
notes: The ETC spec's other worked vendor-code example, 'dd'.

name: Wētā FX
notes: Listed as Weta among ETC industry contributors. No DCNC studio code found.

name: Luma Pictures
notes: ETC industry contributor.

name: Westwyrd Pictures
notes: No ISDCF studio code registered as of this build — recorded empty rather than reserved, because a code you have not registered is a code somebody else may hold. Its shot grammar is the SYN-layer vocabulary of H.SYN.EMA and is the only entry in this dataset written for generated images rather than captured ones.

name: Westwyrd Federated Instruments
notes: Publisher of the H.SYN.EMA format specification and codec design. Listed as a body rather than a studio because it ships formats, not pictures.
